reviews.body: Your customer service is awful. I have been sent round in a circle over and over again for a month. June reset should be June cancellation.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.body: It’s not at all free, yes you get 7 day trial but it same price as as others. Please don’t advertise as free when it’s not, a waste of time

reviews.title: Decent, use to be better
reviews.body: I used this app years ago and really enjoyed it. But now it constantly nags you to pay for premium. The UI is less intuitive and more cluttered with features.

reviews.title: Finding the timer is now woeful
reviews.body: I hadn’t used the app in a while and when I opened it, it said it’s gone back to its roots. I never remember the timer to be so hidden. It’s painful to use now for a timer. Time to find a new timer app.

reviews.title: Used to love it but the shine’s worn off
reviews.body:
I used to love this app. It was simple and intuitive and a could do more or less with it as I chose. Now I have to skip through a zillion irritating survey screens just to use the damn timer. Please stop intervening and trying to make me a program, let me just use the app! I’m quite capable of investigating the menu if I need to. 
/rant ends

reviews.title: I’ve tried….
reviews.body: …to embrace your new format, but it’s troubling. That being said, each time I open the app I get an opportunity to practice managing the negative emotions it triggers. I’m grateful for that opportunity… but, really?

reviews.title: Used to be amazing … not any more
reviews.body: I’ve used this app for many years and it’s been a fantastic way of making a regular meditation practice. There are so many teachers to choose from and I’ve learned so much from them. However recent changes have made the app feel distinctly unmindful. It’s impossible just to save  a guided meditation session without 4 or 5 additional steps. I’d be happy if all the requests to register how you felt were optional but you can’t turn them off.

reviews.title: Recent updates have ruined the experience
reviews.body:
It has been my main meditation app for many years, I pay Plus most for that time and don’t think twice. But the updates make the app hard to navigate…so many clicks to try to find the meditation or teacher you like now. Why do you insist on promoting me about sharing my intentions and feelings every day for your tracking?
You’ve lost sight of what the user needs. It takes like 10 clicks of prompting to finish a meditation.

reviews.title: A once great software
reviews.body: I used to think this software is great. Now after many softwarechanges, the complexity of the software makes it almost unusable.

reviews.title: Bring back old format
reviews.body: Again they changed the format and this one is horrible. I loved the app for the last few years but now they ruined it. GO BACK TO THE PREVIOUS FORMAT

reviews.title: Too complicated now
reviews.body: Since the recent update, the app is slow to open, and hard to locate the simple tasks I used to find in a simple grid. Please go back to what wasn’t broken!  I’m using it far less now.

reviews.title: Again, the ew version is worse than old one
reviews.body: Another update to the app and again, it’s less useful. Why change what is not broken? The bookmarks are now hidden, Home Screen has an endless list of other users (!?!), formerly simple and easy to use app is now more complicated, less useful and makes me feel spied upon. I can only assume it’s an attempt to monetize the content. I would have paid for a simple app, the changes that have been introduced make me more likely to delete Insight Timer.

reviews.title: New app
reviews.body: Please please change back to the last version of the app.

reviews.title: Bring back old ui
reviews.body: I can’t find the timer anymore and it’s very frustrating because that’s all I want from this app. I don’t have a lot of free time in my day so wasting 20 minutes trying to find a timer feels bad.

reviews.title: Where is the timer???
reviews.body: You screwed up the UI. The timer is nowhere to be found.

reviews.title: Nefarious forces at work
reviews.body:
This new update has been terrible to the point of making my once favourite app barely useable. Categories are random; your history is nowhere to be found; and one must travel through a labyrinth of links and menus to arrive at the courses page. 

This might be  tin-foil, but could Dark Forces have commandeered this once beautiful ship in order to stop The Great Awakening?

If that’s paranoid, I can’t be blamed, because my meditation app has sent me on another vision quest before it grants me access to the dulcet tones of Davidji 😬😬😬

reviews.title: It used to be good
reviews.body: I really loved this app and used to use it daily. Recent updates cause it to crash frequently while listening to sessions. The recent changes to the homepage are disappointing and push the social aspect of the app too much. I will not be renewing my subscription unless the quality of the app improves with further updates.

reviews.title: Latest update is awful
reviews.body:
Firstly, the content and teachers on this App are 5 star. My review is about the actual usability of the App. 

I’ve been a full paying Plus member of Insight Timer since its inception (it’s currently almost $90 a year) and I have to say the upgrade that is titled “we’ve gone back to 2018” has to be one of the worst. 

I don’t have the option to customise my Home Screen, so I now get this useless map and a prompt asking my intention. I don’t want to tell the App how I’m feeling or see that someone else is meditating. This is not social media. I just want to be able to search and find a meditation when I’m tired or trying to fall back asleep. 

You really need to think about your user’s state of mind when they are coming to your App. It needs to be smooth and seamless to find everything so you lower my stress levels not increase them. 

Your pop up message asked me to “tell you what I think” but I don’t see anywhere in the App to give feedback so I’m doing it here. 

And please don’t send me a generic reply from your developers saying you’ll help me navigate the new App. I am highly digitally savvy and know how to use Apps. 

If you actually believe in what this App stands for, this feedback is a gift. Please use this gift to fix it - or at least give me the option to change my default Home Screen so I can get straight to the content. Why are you hiding the content when that is what this App is all about?

reviews.title: Annoying pop ups in premium
reviews.body: You’ve paid the premium subscription so I just want to be able to access the content. The constant pop ups of quotes of the day, forcing to set an intention, I don’t need it. And in the middle of the night I just want to get to my stuff and not have to navigate through hoops to find the content. Super frustrating.

reviews.title: Annoying pop ups in premium
reviews.body: You’ve paid the premium subscription so I just want to be able to access the content. The constant pop ups of quotes of the day, forcing to set an intention, I don’t need it. And in the middle of the night I just want to get to my stuff and not have to navigate through hoops to find the content. Super frustrating.

reviews.title: Not enjoying new site
reviews.body: I’m really not enjoying the changes you have made to app. I’m finding it very difficult to try new meditations now, so can only use the ones I have saved.

reviews.title: Going downhill
reviews.body:
I’ve been a long time user of this app for the great mediation timer. I love being able to set different timer intervals. I’m very thankful that the timer in its original form still exists.

Unfortunately the new updates have been making it more and more difficult to use what was a simple and very useful app. Today I opened the app and needed to verify my email and age before I could use the timer. That was frustrating.

I understand that developers need and deserve to make money. And that we live in a time where this is done by monetizing apps and adding community features that make it into a social app.

I cant help but feel disappointed by the new direction.

reviews.title: Very unhappy with the changes
reviews.body: I opened the app today to find a message that said ‘we’re going back to the 2018 format’. I’m not happy with this, it’s clunky and difficult to find what I’m looking for. I can’t search by length of meditation anymore. There’s no search bar anymore. I can’t search by category - where has the yoga gone? I feel for all the teachers whose content is no longer visible. Please change it back. This is not progress.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.body: I used to really enjoy this app - apart from the great selection, it was really easy to use and navigate.  But now I’m lying in bed, ready to use and I can’t because now  have to “verify my email”!!?!  I don’t have email on my phone. I am not getting out of bed to log on to verify an email address on a damn app.   I’ll just use another app instead.  Why do app creators insist on “fixing” things that aren’t broken or making apps so much more complicated than they need to be.   I sugggest checking out Calm or Headspace instead.

reviews.title: Please stop changing Home Screen
reviews.body: Great app with great content but the Home Screen changes are frustrating!!!!

reviews.title: Good Lord so complicated
reviews.body: It used to be simple and straightforward to use, it is now full of drivel and a pain to use

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.body: Love the app, but if I can just request a playlist shortcut for the Home Screen, please.

reviews.title: Good, but they keep making it worse with every update.
reviews.body: I think they are just getting greedy and compromising what used to be the best meditation app.  I am moving on to another one after 8 years of using this one.

reviews.title: Gamification, Steaks, Prompts Yuck
reviews.body: This use to be a simple meditation app, but it’s just getting worse and worse. Gamification in streaks, mood prompts, ratings, donations, feedback. It’s 10 taps to do anything. It’s become bloated and annoying. Make it simple folks.

reviews.title: Won’t let me log in
reviews.body: I was happily using the app and one day it logged me out of it and now it wont let me log in or create a new account it just says “system error”. I lost my streak because of it.

reviews.title: Stupid Update
reviews.body: This latest update rendered this app useless. It keeps asking me a bunch of stupid questions about my intentions and won’t even let me get to the main part of the app to use the timers I have set to meditate with.

reviews.title: System change
reviews.body: It was brilliant how the app used to suggest courses at random. It was great to try new things. Everything is now “tailored to you”. You can also pick newest, popular or highest rated. I just want random ones to come up so I’m trying new courses not based on myself or other people. Please bring this feature back. It’s why I paid for a membership.

reviews.title: New update is step backwards
reviews.body: Great app, but the new update is a step backwards. The previous version had a great scroll option for suggested meditations. Suggestions are still there in the search tab, but no longer user friendly. Meditations also cut out and stop playing if my phone screen locks. This never happened in the previous versions.

reviews.title: Constant log in issues.
reviews.body: Firstly I think this is a great app and maybe this issue just affects me for some reason Every day I’m automatically logged out of the app and face repeated “system error please try again later” when trying to log back in. Previously after several attempts to log back in it works. But now nothing works, regardless of whether I try to log in via Apple or Google. The log in troubleshooting is limited to “you must have forgot your password” which can’t be the case if I log in via Google or Apple. I appreciate the wealth of content provided by this app by the developers, especially as a lot of it is unpaid. It’s a great app, which makes being unable to log in all the more frustrating.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: The new app is awful.  More difficult to do anything.  More complicated.  I would give it zero stars if I could.  Going to lose my streak

reviews.title: Privacy overreach
reviews.body: Once upon a time this was a simple timer with good features. Now it harvests your browsing history.

reviews.title: Well, I USED to love this app…
reviews.body:
It was my daily go-to, at least once every 24 hours. I even recommended it to therapy clients. 

Since the annoying post-meditation pop-ups started, I find myself cursing it every day. It might not seem like a big deal to have to click FIVE times to exit something I’m already done with, but that’s a minimum of 35 times per week, which is almost 2,000 unnecessary clicks per year. (More like 6,000 for me, average.) 

PLEASE, Insight: get rid of all the questions or at least make them optional. I don’t want to tell an app how I’m feeling. I don’t want to add a lame widget to my crowded home screen. 

I’m not the only one who feels this way. I’ve been putting up with it for months without saying anything, so I know there are others.

reviews.title: Annoying!
reviews.body:
I’vei been using the app for years. Big fan. But it’s become increasingly glitchy, there’s no-one to contact and the glitches last for days/weeks. I can’t respond to any messages. I type a response and it disappears. Huh?? Other gripe - too many meditations are ‘low-rent’ …everybody thinks they’re a meditation teacher ..they’re not. Now it’s a wade through a lot of junk to fine good ones. So ..glitches, dysfunctional and dollar store quality.

Still no resolution!
Cant reply to any thank you messages. I tap a teply and it disappears. And it apprats nobody at IT GAF

reviews.title: Good app. Pesters for upgrade
reviews.body: I’m happy using the free level. It’s to the point where to do a basic bell timer it won’t let you do this without you signing up for the paid level. It should not be this hard!

reviews.title: Generally good with some annoyances
reviews.body:
Huge array of content and instructors but the array of options makes the experience a little jarring. For example, “courses” , “challenges “, “playlists” just feel messy add “bookmarks “ and folders to that and it’s super easy to lose your way. There are times I just want a simple guided meditation so I search for that and am confronted with so many courses and options such as guided meditation for sleep, for kids. I can choose between “tracks”, “courses” and “teachers“. Again “tracks” is another paradigm for something. One episode of a course maybe. There’s a salve for every woe of modern life.
On the plus side there are some fantastic teachers and their content available within the app and lots that are not so good. 
I genuinely want to rate it higher as some content is great but the overall design is confusing. Even finding my way back to a course I’m partially through feels a challenge. I would recommend it but for me it’s trying to be all things to all people and becoming cluttered and lacking identity.

reviews.title: Lost the plot
reviews.body:
This app has lost all direction and is attempting to become a social media app.

The basics, like doing actual meditations, are now behind  a sea of TikTok for grandparents style pop ups.

reviews.title: Profiteering
reviews.body:
In “free” mediations, does not have simple functions such as skipping back to beginning or skipping forward to point of need in free meditations…unless your purchase a subscription.

So if you start a 45min mediation, you’re stuck waiting for the whole thing to play out before going back to the beginning again.

A CD, cassette tape, record or live performance has greater functionality.

Mucking around with access to sleep help and anxiety preventing tracks and holding them to ransom is not aiding nor promoting well-being.

When I contacted the app developers they said they were “conducting research”, ie, “how dysfunctional and annoying do we have to make this free app before someone subscribes?”. No further support provided.

Bitter taste left in mouth. Just ick.

Better value paying for a Spotify account and making a meditation playlist with full functionality AND music, or going direct to favourite meditation artists, eg via websites.

reviews.title: App not logging my meditation
reviews.body: Great app but when I revisit the app it hasn’t logged my having done the previous days of on of the meditation journeys. Is there a way to fix this?

reviews.title: Too many popups
reviews.body: Too many forced popups now, should just do the basics well rather than being a product.

reviews.title: Been here since the start
reviews.body: I have seen it go from an exceptional timer (still excellent) to a beautiful example of monetising. A lot of the ‘teachers’ are just self styled influencer types doing the same thing and cashing in. I’m tired of the way the app turns my use of the timer into an annoying wall of notifications and strategically placed clickbait. No, I don’t want to tell you or 675,895 other people how I’m feeling today.

reviews.title: Trapped
reviews.body: Disappointing experience with subscription cancellation. I purchased the app through Apple Wallet and attempted to cancel before the free trial expired. Unfortunately, Insight Timer's support team provided unhelpful, automated responses, leaving me feeling stuck in a loop. I hope the company will improve its customer support to better assist users in the future. Until then, I regret to give zero stars

reviews.title: New setup
reviews.body: Don't like the new version! It's clumsy, difficult to navigate, a pain, hardly use it anymore! Will use less and less as just using my stop watch is easier to be honest. It's just becoming far too complicated! It was fine as it was.

reviews.title: A once great app that’s become lost in complexity
reviews.body: While I initially loved this meditation app for its excellent variety of content and skilled instructors, recent updates have unfortunately compromised its user experience. The interface has become overdesigned, with excessive pop-ups interrupting the experience, particularly after completing meditations. I preferred the app's previous, simpler design which better served its core purpose.

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.body: Being prompted at the end of sessions to install widgets, turn notifications on, and other time-wasting bs does not help me maintain a mindful headspace.

reviews.title: No longer free
reviews.body: Updated the app and now the only function I used the app for is hidden behind a paywall. Immediately deleted, way to ruin your own app!

reviews.title: THIS APP USED TO BE COMPLETELY FREE
reviews.body: I still love this app but the fact that they are capitalising on good mental health makes me ICK. In a modern world where toxic mental health is on the rise and more and more people are falling closer to the poverty line, we need to do better than making money off things like this.

reviews.title: Visually too busy
reviews.body: I really think this app is amazing but it’s too overstimulating which is ironic for a meditation app. For example when you finish your meditation you get asked 5/6 different questions! Did you like it, how would you rate it, how do you feel, what do you want to do today, Geez! I just want to stay in the relaxation I have found and click complete that’s it. PLEASE create a zen interface because this is giving me ADHD!

reviews.title: Tricks you into subscribing
reviews.body: Pretty gross business model for a mental health app to force anyone wanting to try a single meditation to sign up to an annual subscription, and then not allow refunds if they mistakenly don’t unsubscribe.

reviews.title: Sadly, a shadow of its former self.
reviews.body: What used to be a favourite timer app, just leaves me frustrated and cold. It’s just a platform for upselling an overwhelming amount of ‘mediation’s’!! There are far better timers out there, without all the unnecessary distractions!

reviews.title: The app changed over the years
reviews.body:
What a shame. It was a beautiful app that brought me into the world of meditation. It has changed over the past year or so. 

Never ending pop ups at every step of the use. I really don’t want to add the app to widget but it will not stop promoting it to me…

The subscription fees aren’t cheap, and just when I cancelled the auto renewal I saw the price for new subscribers is half of what I’m currently paying. 

The only two stars I’m giving is to a few of the teachers/content creators in the app. Majority of the contents are really, what can I say, not teachers, just content creators.

reviews.title: Too Many Pop-ups
reviews.body: After each meditation there’ll be like 5 pop-ups to add their widget and rate the session and share the session on social media and blah blah blah, which undermines the purity of simply opening the app and doing your meditation and closing the app.

reviews.title: Long duration sleep soundscapes missing as of 2025-01-06
reviews.body: I was recommended Insight Timer by a doctor to help with chronic insomnia and have been using it with great success for over a year. These long duration sleep soundscapes (LDSS) included a timer so that I could know how much sleep I was getting every night and make adjustments to my sleep schedule as needed. These LDSS sessions were able to mask outside noise from traffic — I live 200 metres from the busiest highway in North America. But, as of 2025-01-06 these LDSS’s have disappeared from the app and I am EXTREMELY unhappy about this change. I will need to find a new sleep app that includes long duration sleep soundscapes and cancel my subscription to Insight Timer.

reviews.title: Too many unnecessary changes
reviews.body: This app is constantly adding unnecessary things, especially since it’s a meditation app…lots of clutter. Having to click through three screens to finish a simple timed meditation is terrible UX. The UI is degrading, I can hear a former design instructor saying “too many fonts!”. Why have the numbers changed to a serif? It’s really ugly, every time I open the timer I think “this hurts” design wise. I’m trying to be equanimous with it so there’s that. But my meditation teacher also said there are enough vicissitudes in life there’s no need to add extra suffering. The clicks and fonts are adding extra suffering. If I haven’t been using this app for almost a decade I would have switched three weeks ago. I’m slowly being pushed overboard.

reviews.title: Frightening privacy policy
reviews.body: It’s mandatory to create an account, and they reserve the right to track everything.

reviews.title: F off with the check ins!!!!
reviews.body: Stop asking us to “check in”. I have these notifications turned off but yet “how are you feeling” keeps appearing on my screen anyway. I couldn’t think of anything more toxic than an app asking me to check in . Also please allow us to filter by accent

reviews.title: It’s a scam
reviews.body: Worked long enough to sign up for trial then wouldn’t work as couldn’t connect to server to login to cancel trial. Ended up charging my card for membership before I could cancel.

reviews.title: Too pushy and intrusive for a meditation app
reviews.body: I like the timer, and the library of sound tracks and guided meditations. I don’t like being routinely monitored and questioned but even though I’ve paid the premium I still get chased every time I open the app and again when I’ve finished meditating. Please offer an option to withdraw from statistics, and all the “how are you feeling now?” or “we’re so happy you’re back” stuff.

reviews.title: Please remember the Timer
reviews.body:
I’ve always basically just used Insight Timer as that, a timer. It has great functionality for being a timer with custom bells. 

The problem is it keeps getting harder and harder to do this. Splash screens with messages. Post meditation screens asking you to fill in details. 

All of which, when initially implemented are completely unavoidable. 

Please remember some people just want a timer. If that isn’t the direction the developers want to take can you spin out a ‘just a timer’ version?

reviews.title: It’s not letting me post comments on the daily insight I used to be able to
reviews.body: Are you censoring me? I tried to write about how I love Rumi such a beautiful mystic and Sufi Muslim and that Western translations mostly erase that part of his work. It didn’t let me post even if I shut and opened the app

reviews.title: I used to love this app
reviews.body:
and have supported it on and off for years (through a monthly subscription). However, the app has now become so bloated with features I don’t use that I’ve deleted it in favour of a simple meditation timer. 

I wish they’d release a lite version of the app with just the timer.

reviews.title: Good … but
reviews.body: The app is good. But the fact that I can’t switch off milestones and consecutive days turns mediation into a daily stress of missing a session. At some point, I was ‘faking’ sessions not to miss on consecutive days. Counting them became more important than meditating. Trying to get rid of them, I unintentionally deleted 5 years worth of meditation. It’s stupid to turn a healthy Eastern activity into a Western strive for numbers.

reviews.title: Why so many questions after the meditations?
reviews.body: I’ve been using Insight Timer for years and it’s been great. Lately they’ve updated it so you are inundated with prompts when you finish your meditation - do you want to share? Do you want to add the widget? How are you feeling?!! Previously I turned these off! This is a meditation app for me not social media! Recalling jarring after meditation and the antithesis of calm. It’s so unnecessary

reviews.title: Stop with the annoying pop ups!
reviews.body: Love this up but recent changes are seriously affecting my experience and enjoyment. Annoying pop ups now monitor and ask about meditation practice, how long etc…. Please disable these annoying features, I just want to meditate!!!!

reviews.title: Oh boy
reviews.body: I used to use this daily. I came back in 2024 but the onboarding took so long that I gave up on it. Seriously. Where’s the skip for people who know what they’re doing and just want a timer with occasional guided?

reviews.title: Over complicated
reviews.body: Needed a simple timer but this is massively over complicated. Deleted

reviews.title: End of A Good Thing
reviews.body: I understand why Insight Timer is switching from free to pay up. Everyone wants money and certainly this app is worth paying for a membership. Now when I go on the app, everything is blocked therefore signalling the end of a good thing. Now that I have been cut loose I will take time to explore some of the other apps my friends rave about. If I am to pay, I will look for the best deal and maybe try something new.

reviews.title: ZERO STARS
reviews.body:
I can’t even get into the app … it forces you to “chat” with some AI robot to farm you for personal information before you can even get into the app!!!
NO THANK YOU
Sadly I used this app many years ago when it was just as it said it was - a great meditation timer. 
Now it is a marketing scheme to farm & sell your private & personal information. This is horrendous!!
There isn’t even any options to opt out or skip!!!

reviews.title: Still doesn’t support iOS 18 dark icons
reviews.body: Your app is the ONLY app on my phone that is a bright white app icon, while all others support dark icons. You need to understand the difference between dark mode, and iOS 18 dark icons. You replied to another review ignorantly stating you support dark mode, but that’s not what they’re talking about. They’re talking about the dark icons support in iOS 18. If you don’t update it in 1 week, I will uninstall it. Simple. You have had MONTHS.

reviews.title: Sleep timer disappeared
reviews.body: Content is good but UI is poor! For some reason they removed sleep timer?! Why?! They have replaced it with sleep mode but no explanation as to what that is. I don’t want to play a 2.5 hour track for its entirety as hopefully I’ll fall asleep after 30 minutes, without the ability to set a sleep timer I’ll fall asleep then wake up because of track and I’ll have to turn it off then can get back to sleep. Madness

reviews.title: An app for Plus members
reviews.body: Every meditation I tap on is for plus members. It’s a bit disheartening to be on an app for centring oneself to only be turned away from almost every guided meditation.

reviews.title: This is ridiculous!
reviews.body: I used to love insight timer so much that my friend and I both had it and worked through it daily on everything.  Now they have changed it so that you CANNOT go and read through past challenges, you CANNOT try new challenges they used to have for free.  Not everyone can afford to pay a monthly charge as high as yours! It’s ridiculous and I am very disappointed in Insight Timer! It was there to help those who needed it including me and now I have to find something different, shame on you! You are supposed to help people, not limit them … the challenges were the best part, at least if you kept the past challenges free for people to go back and do again, it would have helped immensely.

reviews.title: New update leaves good stuff out
reviews.body: In the old app you could see your friends and message them easily. Now, it’s the 6k who meditated with you and your friends are not highlighted. It’s harder to send thanks messages.

reviews.title: Overly complicated
reviews.body: Used to be a great app. Now it’s so chock full with unnecessary bells and whistles that the primary function seems lost. Where once you could tap once to start a meditation and once to end it, now takes 1/2 a dozen or more menus and buttons to do the same.

reviews.title: Incredible app, just incredible
reviews.body: Every you need to start, learn and maintain a practice. Genuinely life changing

reviews.title: Tracks browsing history
reviews.body:
Timer app tracking my browser and search history among other private and health information is ridiculous.

It does have a couple really nice tones, but not worth them selling my entire life to ad companies.

reviews.title: Leave the app alone
reviews.body: I wish you would just leave the app alone, every time you update it you make it worse!

reviews.title: Doesn’t Support iOS 18
reviews.body:
Response to developer: Yes, the app supports dark mode, but does not support dark icons. So I have a single white icon on my phone whilst all the others support dark mode icons. 

Original review: Despite several updates to the app since iOS18 launch, Insight Timer are seemingly refusing to support iOS 18c specifically dark mode icons. 

It’s literally the only app on my entire phone that doesn’t support dark mode and so looks ridiculous and has been relegated to my app drawer from my home page. 

This is an otherwise good app, but the aesthetics of my phone matter and IT’s refusal to support dark mode properly just makes the icon stick out like a sore thumb.

reviews.title: Awful experience
reviews.body: Charged for annual subscription without my consent

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.body: I downloaded this app as the description says it’s a free meditation app and want to try to find something which helps me. However when you open the app it requires you to sign up for a one week trial which you would then have to cancel.  So not a free meditation app at all.  Very disappointed. I give it 2 stars because the web version does have some good free meditations but is less convenient to use. The trial is only 7 days and as I have to work 2 jobs I might get one session in that period which is not enough to base the cost of yet another subscription.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.body: This app is was great, until you stop paying, then they delete all your downloads, which took hours to find! This app used to be free. Very scummy. Audible lets you keep your books!

reviews.title: (Un)insightful

reviews.title: Great content, terrible interface
reviews.body: This app breaks my heart. So much good stuff, so hard to access & organize it. A gigantic library but very weak search tools for finding what you want. E.g. thousands of sleep meditations, and hundreds of meditations for depression. But if you want to find the intersection, sleep meditations that address depression, you can’t. Want to search your bookmarks, or just sort them different ways? Nope. Also, playlists are hard to work with cuz you have to switch modes between editing & playing tracks, instead of being able to do both in same mode like most podcast apps let you do. The app is so frustrating you need a guided meditation to deal with the stress of working with it! A real shame & disservice to the teachers who provide all that content.

reviews.title: Cluttered with noise

But still, that’s better than this thing.

reviews.title: To Dear Insight Timer
reviews.body:
Hi to Insight Timer,

Dear Insight Timer, I have been a loyal customer of your service for a while now. And I continue to praise your service with the utmost gratitude. Dear Insight Timer, since I updated this app recently, I have noticed, that there has been changes with the layout of the bookmarked section of the app. I see now you have a list view instead of a tiled view of these bookmarked meditation images, and that you have also placed smaller coloured tiles of the inside of each meditation image. Dear Insight Timer, how I appreciate you. How I love your service. I adore your service and would do anything to help you. It is unfortunately, for me, now, a challenge to try and utilise these bookmarked meditations. As the coloured tiles inserted inside the images make it hard to work with, and the list layout, instead of the tiled view, of the bookmarked section, changes the view as well. Dear Insight Timer, would it be at all possible, if you could add in a free second layout option in the bookmarked list, and without the smaller coloured tiles inserted on top of the images? Just so that people are able to view this original tiled layout, without the smaller coloured tiles that are overlayed on these meditation images? I would be profoundly grateful. I am incredibly grateful for your service and appreciate everything you do 🙏

My love affair with IT seems, sadly, to be ending. We are still friends, but it is standing me up too often. Since it upgraded I have had no end of trouble, first with the timer not turning off when it should, and so recording all sorts of absurdly long (19 hours?!) of mediation in my stats; and now it often takes so long to respond that i think it has frozen (not very soothing at all!!😝) And if anything else happens on my phone while the timer is running (eg I go to a different app for my audio) then the timer stops running in the background. It seems to have become so loaded up with other functions that the basic timer (which for the past several years I have been using three+ times each day) doesnt work properly any more.

Here's my original review from before the two upgrades:

Lovely bells, and a beautiful non-commercial space in which to connect a little with others (with as few words as you please) to support practice. Very inspring to know how many thousands of peeps are meditating at the same time as I am in the privacy of my own room at home.

For beginners who want all the bells and whistles it might still be good. And - who knows - perhaps when I upgrade my iphone 7 plus, the IT app will behave again. But for now I am drifting away from using it, owing to the frustration.

reviews.title: Changes are not an improvement
reviews.body: Insight Timer used to be in my top 5 apps. I have used it every day for nearly 500 days and the new UX changes today are so disappointing. Guys! The quote on white was what I looked forward to before my morning meditation and I have to sift through the menus to find the timer. This is your core feature and you are making it hard to find!!! Feel this is pleasing shareholders (these changes appear to make me experience more of your app) at the expense of me as a meditator. Really disappointed, sorry. Hope it’s not final but as we all know, everything is impermanent so it’s kind of my issue… but still… :) Cheers ⚡️🙏

reviews.title: Good app except update has broken it
reviews.body:
I couldn’t find the place to share technical issues privately, so writing a review instead. The app was working perfectly fine but after updating it recently, I can’t listen to any meditation — it’s stuck on a permanent “downloading” symbol. 

My other apps work perfectly fine.

reviews.title: Where is the Timer now??
reviews.body: Used to use this app for the bell and timers for simple meditation and track the time. Now I can’t even find the timer. Why you still call yourself insight timer?

reviews.title: App is good, customer service terrible.
reviews.body:
Great app with many great teachers to choose from.

Customer service team lacks communication skills and accountability, waste of time to even attempting to communicate with them.

reviews.title: Jill
reviews.body: I just want a bell and I can set for every hour for my mindfulness practice like it used to be, I cannot work out the timer to do this,I feel you took something very simple and useful and turned it into something complicated, very disappointed that you changed this app so drastically.

reviews.title: Interface for navigation is not intuitive
reviews.body: The meditations are good but the developers don’t make them. Since the app updated, it’s become quite confusing to navigate and find your favourite tracks. Front end seriously needs a better design.

reviews.title: Latest version is failing hard.
reviews.body:
Used to love the app, but at least the last 2 versions on iOS are not working properly. The entire session stops abruptly shortly after something is played. 
Seems to have a big with the screen as well. Hiccups when the screen is turned off most of the time now. 
It used to be pretty flawless. How did things go so downhill?
